description: Na₃Mn₂BO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.81 Å. Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ square pyramids that share corners with seven NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-82°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.38 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both B-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Mn atoms to form ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramid, edges with five equivalent ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and three equivalent Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids, edges with five equivalent ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, and edges with five equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one B atom.
